content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Asset-light freight forwarding and customs brokerage, not owning or chartering vessels; different business from LPG carriers."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Owns and charters ships for time and voyage hire to cargo owners; same shipping model, though dry bulk rather than LPG."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Truckload, intermodal and brokerage transport in North America; land freight, not seaborne gas shipping."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Engineering, consulting and government infrastructure services; project-based services, not vessel operation or chartering."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Onshore Permian gas gathering, processing and pipelines; midstream infrastructure, not seaborne carriage of cargoes."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Construction and maintenance contractor for telecom and utility infrastructure; no shipping or vessel business."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Rents and fabricates onshore gas compressor packages for producers; equipment rental, not cargo transport."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Less-than-truckload trucking across North America; land-based freight with different equipment and customers."},{"label":"C9","good":true,"reason":"Owns dry bulk ships, earning voyage and time charter freight from cargo owners; same shipping model, different cargo and vessels."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Oil refiner and fuel marketer with retail stations; manufacturing and retail fuel, not shipping services."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Online and live auctions of used industrial equipment; marketplace fees, not vessel ownership or cargo transport."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"On-site inspection, repair and heat treating services at refineries and plants; maintenance services, not shipping."}]}
